title: ring_scratch allocates on the default heap per growth window and is never freed (comment claims temp-arena lifetime)
detail: append() on a zero-value [dynamic]u32 uses context.allocator, not context.temp_allocator — app/main.odin never overrides it (free_all at main.odin:519 covers temp only). Every dublin growth window that runs the attach ring scan leaks a fresh backing array (up to ~720×u32 ≈ 2.9KB); sibling scratch takes alloc := context.temp_allocator explicitly and growth_board_cluster_has_room's ring has defer delete(ring) — this has neither.
recommended_fix: Allocate it on the temp arena (ring_scratch := make([dynamic]u32, 0, len(board.candidates), context.temp_allocator)) or add defer delete(ring_scratch) beside the declaration.

title: Loader never validates the ODbL attribution field — a board missing it loads clean and renders no credit (hard rule 5)
detail: Every sibling block (board dims, districts, spawn_candidates, terrain, streets) fails loud via map_board_load_fail; attribution — the spec's hard rule 5 ('IP/ODbL attribution renders in-game') — is optional, and dublin_draw_attribution's len==0 guard silently skips the credit, so an asset missing/empty attribution ships with zero error and zero ODbL credit.
recommended_fix: Treat attribution like the other required blocks: fail loud in map_board_load when the key is absent or empty (map_board_load_fail(&b, "map_board_load: missing attribution")).
